meta.note: Curated YC vs non-YC head-to-head rivalries. Opinions only — not investment advice. Not affiliated with Y Combinator.

competitors.name: Adyen
competitors.one_liner: Global payments platform for enterprise checkout.
competitors.description: Adyen is a Netherlands-based payments company used by large global merchants for online and in-person checkout.

competitors.name: Vrbo
competitors.one_liner: Vacation rentals built around whole homes.
competitors.description: Vrbo (Expedia Group) is a vacation-rental marketplace focused on entire homes for families and groups, making it Airbnb's closest like-for-like rival.

competitors.name: Uber Eats
competitors.one_liner: Food delivery network built on Uber's logistics.
competitors.description: Uber Eats competes in on-demand restaurant delivery across most major cities.

competitors.name: Binance
competitors.one_liner: High-volume global crypto exchange.
competitors.description: Binance is a major cryptocurrency exchange known for deep liquidity and a wide asset list.

competitors.name: Google Drive
competitors.one_liner: Cloud storage bundled with Google Workspace.
competitors.description: Google Drive is the default cloud file system for many teams already on Gmail/Docs.

competitors.name: Amazon Fresh
competitors.one_liner: Grocery delivery from Amazon's logistics stack.
competitors.description: Amazon Fresh brings grocery delivery into Amazon's Prime membership and fulfillment network.

competitors.name: ADP
competitors.one_liner: Incumbent payroll and HR platform for enterprises.
competitors.description: ADP is a long-running payroll and HCM provider for SMBs through large enterprises.

competitors.name: American Express
competitors.one_liner: Premium cards and corporate spend brand.
competitors.description: American Express dominates premium consumer and corporate card spend with rewards and charge products.

competitors.name: YouTube
competitors.one_liner: Dominant video platform with live streaming.
competitors.description: YouTube is the default destination for on-demand and live video creators and audiences.

competitors.name: Jira
competitors.one_liner: Atlassian's default issue tracker for engineering teams.
competitors.description: Jira is the incumbent project and issue tracking suite for software organizations.

competitors.name: Labelbox
competitors.one_liner: Data labeling and training-data platform for ML teams.
competitors.description: Labelbox helps teams create and manage labeled datasets for machine learning.

competitors.name: Render
competitors.one_liner: Modern cloud host for web apps and services.
competitors.description: Render competes as a developer-friendly alternative to classic PaaS for deploying web services.

competitors.name: Procore
competitors.one_liner: Public construction management platform for project and field teams.
competitors.description: Procore Technologies (NYSE: PCOR) is a global construction management platform covering project management, quality, safety, and cost control.

competitors.name: iGUIDE
competitors.one_liner: 3D tours and measurement-grade floor plans for real estate listings.
competitors.description: iGUIDE, made by Planitar Inc., combines laser measurement and 360-degree imagery to produce accurate floor plans and virtual tours for real estate; REA Group acquired a majority stake in 2025.

competitors.name: Pendo
competitors.one_liner: Product experience platform combining analytics, in-app guides, and feedback.
competitors.description: Pendo is a product analytics and digital adoption platform used by product teams to track usage, guide users in-app, and collect feedback.

competitors.name: Remitly
competitors.one_liner: Public digital remittance app for international money transfers.
competitors.description: Remitly (Nasdaq: RELY) is a digital remittance company offering international money transfers to more than 170 countries.

competitors.name: DataCamp
competitors.one_liner: Interactive online courses for data science, coding, and AI skills.
competitors.description: DataCamp offers browser-based interactive courses in Python, R, SQL, and data science topics for individuals and enterprise teams.

competitors.name: mParticle
competitors.one_liner: Customer data platform for real-time data collection and activation.
competitors.description: mParticle is a customer data platform (CDP) that unifies and routes customer data across marketing, analytics, and product tools.

competitors.name: DocuSign
competitors.one_liner: Public market leader in e-signature and agreement management.
competitors.description: DocuSign (Nasdaq: DOCU) is the category-defining e-signature platform used across consumer and enterprise workflows.

competitors.name: Square
competitors.one_liner: Payments and point-of-sale platform with built-in loyalty and marketing tools.
competitors.description: Square, part of Block, Inc. (NYSE: XYZ), provides point-of-sale, payments, and loyalty/marketing tools used heavily by small businesses.

competitors.name: StockX
competitors.one_liner: Bid/ask marketplace for authenticated sneakers, streetwear, and collectibles.
competitors.description: StockX is a Detroit-founded 'stock market of things' marketplace for buying and selling authenticated sneakers and streetwear.

competitors.name: athenahealth
competitors.one_liner: Cloud-based EHR and practice management for medical groups.
competitors.description: athenahealth provides cloud EHR, revenue cycle, and practice management software for medical practices and health systems.

competitors.name: Opsgenie
competitors.one_liner: On-call scheduling and incident alerting tool now owned by Atlassian.
competitors.description: Opsgenie provides on-call scheduling, alerting, and incident response for engineering and ops teams, acquired by Atlassian in 2018.

competitors.name: VWO
competitors.one_liner: A/B testing and conversion optimization platform.
competitors.description: VWO, built by Wingify, is an experimentation and conversion-rate-optimization platform used by thousands of brands worldwide.

competitors.name: Adobe Analytics
competitors.one_liner: Enterprise web and app analytics suite within Adobe Experience Cloud.
competitors.description: Adobe Analytics is Adobe's enterprise-grade analytics product for tracking customer behavior across web and mobile.

competitors.name: Kindle Unlimited
competitors.one_liner: Amazon's all-you-can-read ebook and audiobook subscription.
competitors.description: Kindle Unlimited is Amazon's subscription reading service offering access to millions of ebooks and audiobooks.

competitors.name: Discord
competitors.one_liner: Voice, video, and text chat platform built around communities.
competitors.description: Discord hosts millions of community servers for gaming, interest groups, and creators, competing for the same online-community attention as forums like Reddit.

competitors.name: ClassLink
competitors.one_liner: Identity and rostering platform for K-12 school districts.
competitors.description: ClassLink provides single sign-on, class rostering, and analytics for schools, competing directly with Clever for district-level access management contracts.

competitors.name: NerdWallet
competitors.one_liner: Public personal-finance comparison and content platform.
competitors.description: NerdWallet is a Nasdaq-listed personal finance site that compares financial products and, like SmartAsset, connects readers with financial advisors and services.

competitors.name: Greenhouse
competitors.one_liner: Structured hiring platform with scorecards and compliance tooling.
competitors.description: Greenhouse is an applicant tracking and hiring platform known for structured interview workflows, competing head-to-head with Lever for mid-market and enterprise recruiting teams.

competitors.name: Make
competitors.one_liner: Visual, canvas-based workflow automation platform.
competitors.description: Make (formerly Integromat, now owned by Celonis) lets users build complex, branching automations on a visual canvas, competing directly with Zapier in no-code automation.

competitors.name: Dotmatics
competitors.one_liner: Scientific informatics suite for biotech and pharma R&D.
competitors.description: Dotmatics (now owned by Siemens) offers ELN, LIMS, and chemistry-aware data tools for life-science R&D teams, and is the most frequently cited rival to Benchling.

competitors.name: Matillion
competitors.one_liner: Cloud-native ETL/ELT platform for data warehouses.
competitors.description: Matillion builds and manages data pipelines with low-code, push-down transformations for cloud data platforms, competing with Fivetran in data integration.

competitors.name: Amplitude
competitors.one_liner: Public product analytics platform for digital teams.
competitors.description: Amplitude is a Nasdaq-listed product analytics company that competes with Heap on event tracking, funnels, and behavioral analysis for product teams.

competitors.name: Framer
competitors.one_liner: Design-canvas website builder focused on speed and motion.
competitors.description: Framer lets designers build and publish sites directly from a design canvas with heavy animation support, and is widely cited as Webflow's leading 2026 no-code rival.

competitors.name: Oura
competitors.one_liner: Smart ring for sleep, readiness, and biometric tracking.
competitors.description: Oura makes a ring-form wearable tracking sleep, activity, and cycle health, competing with Bellabeat for the wellness-wearable market including women's health features.

competitors.name: Freightos
competitors.one_liner: Public vendor-neutral booking and payment platform for global freight.
competitors.description: Freightos (Nasdaq: CRGO) digitizes freight booking and payments across ocean, air, and land carriers, and is listed among Flexport's primary competitors in digital freight forwarding.

competitors.name: Solutionreach
competitors.one_liner: Patient communication and recall platform for medical and dental practices.
competitors.description: Solutionreach provides automated reminders, recall, and review-request tools for healthcare practices, and is described as Weave's most direct functional competitor.

competitors.name: Elastic
competitors.one_liner: Public search, observability, and security data platform.
competitors.description: Elastic (NYSE: ESTC), maker of Elasticsearch, offers self-managed and cloud search infrastructure with deep query control, a common comparison point against Algolia's managed search API.
competitors.location: Amsterdam, Netherlands; San Francisco, CA, USA

competitors.name: First Advantage
competitors.one_liner: Public global employment background screening provider.
competitors.description: First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA) is a long-established background check and screening company, listed by Checkr itself as a direct competitor.

competitors.name: IonQ
competitors.one_liner: Public trapped-ion quantum computing company.
competitors.description: IonQ (NYSE: IONQ) builds trapped-ion quantum computers and cloud access, and is routinely ranked alongside Rigetti as one of the two leading pure-play quantum computing stocks.

competitors.name: ShipMonk
competitors.one_liner: Tech-driven third-party fulfillment for e-commerce brands.
competitors.description: ShipMonk operates a multi-warehouse fulfillment network with inventory software for DTC and e-commerce brands, competing directly with ShipBob in outsourced fulfillment.

competitors.name: Twist Bioscience
competitors.one_liner: Public synthetic DNA manufacturer for biotech and pharma.
competitors.description: Twist Bioscience makes synthetic DNA at scale on a silicon-based platform, supplying biotech, pharma, and industrial biology customers, including Ginkgo itself.

competitors.name: NuScale Power
competitors.one_liner: Public small modular reactor developer for carbon-free power.
competitors.description: NuScale Power designs and licenses small modular nuclear reactors, and was the first SMR maker to win NRC design approval and go public.

competitors.name: Sysco
competitors.one_liner: Largest foodservice distributor in North America.
competitors.description: Sysco is the incumbent broadline food distributor supplying restaurants, healthcare, and education customers across North America.

competitors.name: United Rentals
competitors.one_liner: World's largest equipment rental company.
competitors.description: United Rentals rents construction and industrial equipment through thousands of locations across North America and Europe.

competitors.name: GitHub
competitors.one_liner: Microsoft-owned home for open-source and enterprise code.
competitors.description: GitHub hosts code, issues, and CI/CD workflows for most of the world's developers, and has been owned by Microsoft since 2018.

competitors.name: PayU
competitors.one_liner: Prosus-owned payments gateway operating across 50+ markets.
competitors.description: PayU is a global payments and fintech provider owned by Prosus, with deep reach in India through its BillDesk acquisition.

competitors.name: Scentbox
competitors.one_liner: Fragrance sampling subscription rivaling Scentbird.
competitors.description: Scentbox is a monthly fragrance subscription service offering hundreds of scents to sample before buying a full bottle.

competitors.name: LinkedIn Learning
competitors.one_liner: Microsoft-owned video course library for career skills.
competitors.description: LinkedIn Learning offers on-demand video courses for workplace and technical skills, bundled with LinkedIn's professional network.

competitors.name: Trim
competitors.one_liner: OneMain-owned bill negotiation and subscription-cancellation app.
competitors.description: Trim automatically finds and cancels unwanted subscriptions and negotiates bills on behalf of users; it is now owned by OneMain Financial.

competitors.name: Interswitch
competitors.one_liner: Longstanding Nigerian payments and switching infrastructure.
competitors.description: Interswitch is a Nigerian payments and digital commerce company founded in 2002, powering card switching, processing, and the Verve card network across Africa.

competitors.name: Birdeye
competitors.one_liner: AI-driven reputation and customer experience platform.
competitors.description: Birdeye helps multi-location brands manage reviews, messaging, and listings, competing directly with Podium for local-business customer engagement.

competitors.name: Zippin
competitors.one_liner: Computer-vision checkout-free store technology.
competitors.description: Zippin builds cashierless checkout systems for retailers, using cameras and sensors that let shoppers grab items and walk out without scanning.

competitors.name: Hims & Hers Health
competitors.one_liner: Public telehealth brand for prescriptions delivered by mail.
competitors.description: Hims & Hers is a publicly traded telehealth company selling prescriptions and treatments for sexual health, hair loss, mental health, and more.

competitors.name: iFood
competitors.one_liner: Dominant Brazilian food delivery app, owned by Prosus.
competitors.description: iFood commands over 80% of Brazil's food delivery market and is fully owned by Prosus and its affiliate Movile.

competitors.name: Flipkart
competitors.one_liner: Walmart-owned e-commerce marketplace leader in India.
competitors.description: Flipkart is India's largest e-commerce marketplace by GMV, majority-owned by Walmart since 2018.

competitors.name: Sports Illustrated
competitors.one_liner: Legacy sports media brand now licensed to Minute Media.
competitors.description: Sports Illustrated is a decades-old sports journalism brand now published under a 10-year license by Minute Media on behalf of brand owner Authentic Brands Group.

competitors.name: Sinch
competitors.one_liner: Public CPaaS company for messaging, voice, and email at scale.
competitors.description: Sinch is a Sweden-based, publicly traded (XSTO: SINCH) communications platform providing SMS, voice, and email APIs for enterprises worldwide.

competitors.name: BambooHR
competitors.one_liner: HR software built for small and midsize businesses.
competitors.description: BambooHR is a privately held HR information system (HRIS) covering hiring, onboarding, payroll, and benefits for SMBs.

competitors.name: ShiftKey
competitors.one_liner: Marketplace connecting healthcare facilities with independent shift workers.
competitors.description: ShiftKey is a Texas-based platform that lets healthcare facilities fill open shifts with independent, credentialed professionals, valued at over $2B.

competitors.name: Ankorstore
competitors.one_liner: European B2B wholesale marketplace for independent retailers.
competitors.description: Ankorstore is a Paris-based wholesale marketplace connecting independent brands with retailers across Europe, valued at roughly $2B.

competitors.name: Motorola Solutions (Vigilant)
competitors.one_liner: Public safety technology giant with license-plate recognition via Vigilant.
competitors.description: Motorola Solutions is a public technology company (NYSE: MSI) whose Vigilant Solutions unit runs one of the largest commercial ALPR camera and database networks in North America.

competitors.name: Embroker
competitors.one_liner: Digital commercial insurance brokerage for startups and SMBs.
competitors.description: Embroker is a tech-first insurance brokerage offering self-serve commercial coverage for startups and small businesses.

competitors.name: Everlywell
competitors.one_liner: At-home lab testing brand covering fertility, hormones, and more.
competitors.description: Everlywell sells CLIA-lab-backed at-home health tests, including a women's fertility/hormone panel, shipped direct to consumers.

competitors.name: Zerodha
competitors.one_liner: India's largest bootstrapped discount stockbroker.
competitors.description: Zerodha is a profitable, entirely self-funded Indian brokerage offering zero-commission equity delivery trading and direct mutual funds.

competitors.name: Skims
competitors.one_liner: Kim Kardashian's shapewear and loungewear label.
competitors.description: Skims is a Los Angeles-based "solutionwear" and shapewear brand co-founded by Kim Kardashian and Jens Grede.

competitors.name: Rocket Lab
competitors.one_liner: Public launch and space-systems company.
competitors.description: Rocket Lab (NASDAQ: RKLB) is a publicly traded space company offering launch, satellite, and in-space/orbital transfer services.

competitors.name: M-Pesa
competitors.one_liner: Africa's dominant mobile money network.
competitors.description: M-Pesa is the mobile money service jointly run by Safaricom and Vodacom, dominant across Kenya and much of East and Southern Africa.

competitors.name: Remote
competitors.one_liner: Global HR, payroll, and Employer-of-Record platform.
competitors.description: Remote is a VC-backed global employment platform offering EOR, payroll, and contractor management, competing directly with Deel.

competitors.name: DHL Global Forwarding
competitors.one_liner: Legacy global freight forwarding arm of Deutsche Post DHL.
competitors.description: DHL Global Forwarding is one of the world's largest traditional air and ocean freight forwarders, part of the publicly traded Deutsche Post DHL Group.

competitors.name: Toast
competitors.one_liner: Public restaurant point-of-sale and operations platform.
competitors.description: Toast (NYSE: TOST) is a restaurant-focused POS, payments, and operations platform used broadly across cafes and restaurants.

competitors.name: TikTok Shop
competitors.one_liner: ByteDance's in-app livestream and social shopping marketplace.
competitors.description: TikTok Shop is ByteDance's social-commerce and livestream shopping feature built into the TikTok app.

competitors.name: Blinkit
competitors.one_liner: India's leading 10-minute grocery delivery app.
competitors.description: Blinkit, owned by publicly traded Eternal Ltd (formerly Zomato), is India's largest quick-commerce grocery delivery service by market share.

battles.title: Stripe vs Adyen
battles.left_argument: Developer-first APIs, docs, and startup default.
battles.right_argument: Enterprise global acquiring and unified commerce at scale.

battles.title: Airbnb vs Vrbo
battles.left_argument: Homes and experiences brand with community trust.
battles.right_argument: Whole-home vacation rentals built for families and groups.

battles.title: DoorDash vs Uber Eats
battles.left_argument: US density and merchant tooling focus.
battles.right_argument: Global Uber network and multi-vertical logistics.

battles.title: Coinbase vs Binance
battles.left_argument: US-regulated brand and retail trust.
battles.right_argument: Liquidity, listings, and global volume.

battles.title: Dropbox vs Google Drive
battles.left_argument: Focused sync product and cross-platform files.
battles.right_argument: Free bundling with Google account and Docs.

battles.title: Instacart vs Amazon Fresh
battles.left_argument: Retailer marketplace and local shopper network.
battles.right_argument: Prime logistics and Amazon retail gravity.

battles.title: Gusto vs ADP
battles.left_argument: SMB-friendly UX and modern benefits stack.
battles.right_argument: Enterprise compliance breadth and incumbency.

battles.title: Brex vs American Express
battles.left_argument: Startup spend controls and software-native cards.
battles.right_argument: Rewards brand and corporate charge network.

battles.title: Twitch vs YouTube
battles.left_argument: Live community culture and gaming identity.
battles.right_argument: Audience scale and creator monetization surface.

battles.title: Heroku vs Render
battles.left_argument: Original developer PaaS with add-on ecosystem.
battles.right_argument: Modern pricing and DX without legacy baggage.

battles.title: Scale AI vs Labelbox
battles.left_argument: Full-stack data engine for frontier AI labs.
battles.right_argument: Self-serve labeling workflows for ML teams.

battles.title: PlanGrid vs Procore
battles.left_argument: Mobile-first blueprints and field markup that construction crews adopted early.
battles.right_argument: Public-company platform that's become the default for end-to-end construction management.

battles.title: Matterport vs iGUIDE
battles.left_argument: Public 3D-capture leader known for its dollhouse-view digital twins.
battles.right_argument: Measurement-grade floor plans trusted by Canadian appraisers and agents.

battles.title: Amplitude vs Pendo
battles.left_argument: Public product-analytics platform built for deep behavioral data and experimentation.
battles.right_argument: Combines analytics with in-app guides and feedback in one product-led-growth suite.

battles.title: Sendwave vs Remitly
battles.left_argument: No-fee, app-first transfers focused on Africa and Asia corridors.
battles.right_argument: Public-market scale across 170+ countries and mainstream brand trust.

battles.title: Codecademy vs DataCamp
battles.left_argument: Broad interactive curriculum spanning web development, coding fundamentals, and career paths.
battles.right_argument: Data science and analytics-focused courses used heavily by industry teams.

battles.title: Segment vs mParticle
battles.left_argument: Twilio-owned CDP that pioneered simple one-line data collection APIs.
battles.right_argument: Real-time CDP built for mobile-first and enterprise data orchestration.

battles.title: HelloSign vs DocuSign
battles.left_argument: Simple, developer-friendly e-signatures now bundled into Dropbox.
battles.right_argument: The category-defining public e-signature brand with the widest enterprise reach.

battles.title: Fivestars vs Square
battles.left_argument: Cross-merchant loyalty network now backed by SumUp's scale.
battles.right_argument: Payments-native loyalty and marketing tools bundled into the point-of-sale system merchants already run.

battles.title: GOAT Group vs StockX
battles.left_argument: Authentication-first marketplace with deep sneakerhead community roots.
battles.right_argument: Bid/ask 'stock market of things' model and first-mover brand in resale.

battles.title: DrChrono vs athenahealth
battles.left_argument: iPad-first EHR and billing built for small and mobile practices.
battles.right_argument: Established cloud EHR and revenue-cycle platform used by large medical groups.

battles.title: PagerDuty vs Opsgenie
battles.left_argument: Public, standalone incident response platform deeply integrated into engineering workflows.
battles.right_argument: On-call alerting bundled into the Atlassian suite teams already run.

battles.title: Optimizely vs VWO
battles.left_argument: Enterprise experimentation platform now part of a broader digital experience suite.
battles.right_argument: Bootstrapped-turned-PE-backed A/B testing platform serving thousands of global brands.

battles.title: Mixpanel vs Adobe Analytics
battles.left_argument: Self-serve event analytics built for product teams that need fast answers.
battles.right_argument: Enterprise analytics suite bundled into Adobe Experience Cloud.

battles.title: Scribd vs Kindle Unlimited
battles.left_argument: Multi-format library (now Everand) spanning ebooks, audiobooks, and documents with a social reading layer.
battles.right_argument: Amazon-scale ebook and audiobook catalog bundled into the Kindle ecosystem.

battles.title: Reddit vs Discord
battles.left_argument: Searchable public forums and threads for every topic imaginable.
battles.right_argument: Real-time voice and chat servers where communities actually hang out.

battles.title: Clever vs ClassLink
battles.left_argument: Widely adopted classroom single sign-on with a huge app-library.
battles.right_argument: District-first identity and rostering platform, free to districts.

battles.title: SmartAsset vs NerdWallet
battles.left_argument: Matches consumers directly with vetted financial advisors.
battles.right_argument: Broad personal-finance comparison engine with massive organic reach.

battles.title: Lever vs Greenhouse
battles.left_argument: ATS plus CRM in one suite, built for proactive pipeline building.
battles.right_argument: Structured, enterprise-grade hiring workflows and scorecards.

battles.title: Zapier vs Make
battles.left_argument: 7,000+ app integrations and the simplest builder for quick automations.
battles.right_argument: Visual canvas built for complex, branching multi-step workflows.

battles.title: Benchling vs Dotmatics
battles.left_argument: Cloud-native ELN/LIMS built molecular-biology-first for modern biotech.
battles.right_argument: Broad scientific informatics suite with deep chemistry support.

battles.title: Fivetran vs Matillion
battles.left_argument: Zero-maintenance managed ELT with 700+ connectors.
battles.right_argument: Cloud-native ETL with AI-assisted, low-code pipeline building.

battles.title: Heap vs Amplitude
battles.left_argument: Auto-captures every user interaction with no manual event tagging.
battles.right_argument: Mature, plan-and-tag analytics suite trusted at enterprise scale.

battles.title: Webflow vs Framer
battles.left_argument: Mature visual CMS for complex, content-heavy sites with strong SEO.
battles.right_argument: Design-canvas-first builder built for speed and motion.

battles.title: Bellabeat vs Oura
battles.left_argument: Jewelry-like wearable built around women's hormonal and cycle health.
battles.right_argument: Ring-form biometric tracker with deep sleep and readiness data.

battles.title: Flexport vs Freightos
battles.left_argument: Full-service freight forwarder with an end-to-end tech platform.
battles.right_argument: Vendor-neutral booking and payment marketplace for global freight.

battles.title: Weave vs Solutionreach
battles.left_argument: All-in-one VOIP phone system plus texting and payments for practices.
battles.right_argument: Communication layer with reminders, recall, and review requests.

battles.title: Algolia vs Elastic
battles.left_argument: Managed, API-first search built for fast front-end developer experience.
battles.right_argument: Self-hosted-or-cloud search engine with full query control at scale.

battles.title: Checkr vs First Advantage
battles.left_argument: API-first, highly automated screening built for modern hiring platforms.
battles.right_argument: Long-established global screening provider with enterprise scale.

battles.title: Rigetti Computing vs IonQ
battles.left_argument: Superconducting-qubit quantum processors with cloud access.
battles.right_argument: Trapped-ion quantum systems with faster-growing commercial revenue.

battles.title: ShipBob vs ShipMonk
battles.left_argument: Distributed fulfillment network built for fast-growing DTC brands.
battles.right_argument: Growth-equity-backed 3PL with tech-driven multi-warehouse fulfillment.

battles.title: Ginkgo Bioworks vs Twist Bioscience
battles.left_argument: Full-stack biology foundry that designs and engineers organisms for customers.
battles.right_argument: The DNA supplier of record, manufacturing synthetic genes at industrial scale, including for Ginkgo.

battles.title: Oklo vs NuScale Power
battles.left_argument: Fast fission micro-reactors aimed at data centers and remote power.
battles.right_argument: First small modular reactor design to win NRC approval and go public.

battles.title: GrubMarket vs Sysco
battles.left_argument: Tech-enabled marketplace and software modernizing food supply chains.
battles.right_argument: The incumbent broadline distributor restaurants and institutions already rely on.

battles.title: EquipmentShare vs United Rentals
battles.left_argument: Telematics-driven rental and fleet software built for contractors.
battles.right_argument: The world's largest equipment rental company by fleet and locations.

battles.title: GitLab vs GitHub
battles.left_argument: Single-application DevSecOps platform, public since 2021.
battles.right_argument: The default home for open-source and enterprise code, owned by Microsoft.

battles.title: Razorpay vs PayU
battles.left_argument: India's full-stack payments and banking infrastructure provider.
battles.right_argument: Prosus-owned gateway with deep reach across 50+ global markets.

battles.title: Scentbird vs Scentbox
battles.left_argument: Indie-friendly fragrance subscription with 450+ brands.
battles.right_argument: Rival fragrance sampler offering 575+ scents and multi-sample plans.

battles.title: Go1 vs LinkedIn Learning
battles.left_argument: Aggregates 250+ content providers into one corporate learning library.
battles.right_argument: Microsoft-owned video course library bundled with the LinkedIn network.

battles.title: Truebill vs Trim
battles.left_argument: Now Rocket Money — tracks spending and cancels unwanted subscriptions at scale.
battles.right_argument: OneMain-owned rival that negotiates bills and cancels subscriptions on your behalf.

battles.title: Paystack vs Interswitch
battles.left_argument: Stripe-owned payments API popular with African startups and merchants.
battles.right_argument: Nigeria's longstanding payments and card-switching infrastructure incumbent.

battles.title: Podium vs Birdeye
